The implementation is complete and fully verified.

## Summary

**`/work/submission/main.py`** — 17.4 KB regular file, stdlib only (`heapq`, `json`, `re`, `sys`):

**1. Strict input gate** — bounded read (rejects >2 MiB), strict UTF-8, duplicate-key detection (`object_pairs_hook`), float/NaN/Infinity rejection (`parse_float`/`parse_constant`), exact key sets for root/edge/round objects, every documented bound (n, capacity, `0≤u<v<n`, no parallel edges, delays, label regex, launch/timeout/host_delay, distinct valid drop IDs), plus the ≤8192 source→destination path bound via a capped DP. Any violation → `{"error":"invalid-input"}` + exit 2.

**2. Discrete-event replay** — min-heap keyed `(time, priority, round_id, event_key)` giving exactly the specified ordering (release → PING → reverse ACK → timeout → host ACK). Cache entries per `(round, node)` hold bitmask proof/credited/parent sets; capacity is shared across rounds; PING handling follows the specified order (late → dedup(+cached ACK to finalized entry) → capacity drop → allocate/forward/schedule timeout → zero-outdegree immediate `complete=true`); ACK payloads are frozen at transmission and subject to `drop_ack`; timeout finalizes with `complete=false` retaining accepted proof; source finalization records the certificate and emits the host ACK (delivered even after release); peaks update after every allocation; releases at `deadline+1` for every round; `end_us` = last popped event.

**3. Evidence/ambiguity** — iterative reachability-pruned DFS enumerates all concrete paths, groups them by ordered label signature, and per *delivered* round checks `path_mask | proof == proof` (no cross-round union), then emits classes (lexicographically sorted, prefixes first), states, witnesses, and the full summary/coverage logic.

**Validation performed**: public example byte-semantic MATCH; 30 hand-computed unit tests (deadline boundaries, same-timestamp priority interactions, timeout-key ordering, dedup/cached ACK, cross-round capacity blocking, dead ends, drops, peaks, concatenation evidence, class sorting); ~17,000 randomized cross-checks against an independently written time-bucket simulator that also asserted the "one event per (time,priority,round,key)" invariant; 1,500 schema/invariant runs including bidirectional recomputation of the evidence relation; a ~90-case CLI invalid/boundary suite; pathological-input robustness (deep nesting, huge ints, invalid UTF-8, BOM, oversize, empty); max-size stress (96 nodes/384 edges/48 rounds/8192 paths, 82-edge signatures) at 0.32 s, 45 MiB RSS, ≤9.5 MiB stdout — far inside every ceiling.
